name: Almanac
summary: A gardener's almanac. The first screen is the year: twelve tall photographs of plants from the studio's own gardens side by side, the visitor's month standing open with its name across it in italic; under it, the studio's page for that month, what it is designing, building, planting and caring for, and when it can start. Then design, build and care in a line each, the gardens by kind, one garden through the year, reviews and visit. Ivory ground and ink, the photographs carry the colour; a rose hip gives the one accent (one word a screen, the chosen month, focus), and low sun on stone the warm tone of the sun study. One serif, Alegreya, for everything: italic for months, labels and plant names. For garden designers, landscapers and garden-care firms.
